title: Succession law
description: How a title passes when its holder dies. The law is the reason this game is a Crusader Kings clone rather than a map-painting game, so it gets its own record kind rather than being an enum on a title.

kind.description: Primogeniture: eldest child. Ultimogeniture: youngest. Gavelkind: divided among children. Seniority: eldest dynasty member. Elective: chosen by electors. Appointment: chosen by the liege.

gender_law.description: Agnatic: men only. Agnatic-cognatic: women inherit only when no man qualifies. Absolute cognatic: birth order regardless of sex. Enatic: women only.

description.description: Prose explanation of how this law divides a realm, written for a reader who has not played Crusader Kings.
